Browse the palettes

Source: vignettes/articles/browse.Rmd
browse.Rmd

Every colorway in glyospalettes, with its colors, where it came from, and a photo of the figure it was sampled from. Filter by company, product line or what kind of plot it suits, click a swatch to copy its hex code, and use Suggest a change on any card to open a prefilled GitHub issue where you can propose different colors or attach a cleaner photograph.

Suits:

Copied

Suggesting changes

Every palette here is an approximation read off a photograph, so corrections are welcome. Each card links to a prefilled GitHub issue form:

  • Suggest a change if a color is wrong, missing, or should be removed. Say which hex codes you would add, change or drop and why; a photo of the figure under neutral light is the best evidence.
  • Submit a cleaner photo if you have a shot of the figure on a plain background. Cleaner photos let the color sampling run without picking up rocks, tables and studio walls. You can drag an image straight into the issue form.
  • Propose a new colorway if a figure or wave you care about is not covered yet.

You need a GitHub account to open an issue. If you would rather not, email the maintainer listed in the package DESCRIPTION.
